Short Bio (for press)

Giovani Baroni is a Brazilian musician, songwriter, vocalist, and producer. His debut solo album bLU — a psychedelic journey through water and memory — is his most ambitious work to date.

Long Bio (for press)

Giovani Baroni is a musician, songwriter, vocalist, and producer based in [UPDATE: city, country].

Working under multiple names and across multiple genres, Baroni has built a body of work that spans solo releases and collaborative projects, all connected by a singular sensibility: emotionally direct, sonically adventurous, and deeply personal.

His band sukya || porno has released two EPs of noisy, experimental rock. His earlier solo EP, Stop & Go Station, established his voice as an intimate and searching songwriter. His upcoming debut album bLU marks a new creative threshold — an immersive, psychedelic record made entirely on his own terms.
